<!--
A ticket for pybers, filed by a maintainer. `/ticket-create` writes the same shape and files it.

Title: at most about 60 characters, imperative and verb-first, sentence case, no trailing
punctuation. It becomes the branch name, the pull request title and the CHANGELOG entry.

Label: exactly one of feat, fix, perf, refactor, docs or chore.
-->

As a [role] I want [outcome] so that [reason].

## Acceptance criteria

<!--
Each criterion states an outcome someone can check, never how the code is built. Number every
line `1.`, since Markdown counts them. One level of nesting at most, cited as `4.ii`.
-->

1. [an outcome someone can check]
1. [another]
   1. [a nested outcome, cited as 2.i]

## Constraints

<!--
Usually absent, so delete this section when nothing belongs here. Two or three lines at most,
each a fact already established that a competent build would otherwise get wrong without
failing. Never a plan.
-->

- [a measured fact that rules out the obvious approach]
